fixtures.budget_note: The seven 1048576-byte values are synthetic parser fixtures copied from v22; they are not real acceptance budgets and are not certified for real extraction.

plan.encoding: canonical ASCII TSV with final LF
plan.partial_encrypted_sections: declared-skip; mandatory in the PLAN only, immediately between decryption and collision-storage
plan.db2_entries: exactly one canonical Map DB2 entry; no other table

package.manifest: forever-package.json with deterministic per-table partial-section declarations only
package.partial_encrypted_tables: Use the v26/v27 per-table declaration contract for every selected table with TACT-declared available-source sections, including Map when partial: deterministic [{lookup, frame_ordinal, decoded_size}] bound to the containing DB2 path. A complete table has no declaration.
package.partial_encrypted_sections: forbidden in the package manifest; the same-named PLAN gate remains mandatory
package.global_partial_encrypted_sections: forbidden; no v25-style global or package-wide declaration is admitted
package.declaration_boundary: Only per-table partial_encrypted_tables declarations are admitted. Map follows the same v26/v27 rule, including exact ordered multi-frame coverage of each TACT-declared extent; no global or package-wide partial-section declaration is permitted.

strict_wrappers.foreign_or_mixed_masks: rejected by each profile-specific verify and verify-links wrapper before coverage acceptance

context.binding: The v28 coverage context and sealed package context must match each other and the canonical v28 PLAN; mask 16 and every foreign mask reject.

source_policy.db2_map: Publish exactly the selected canonical Map FDID 1349477 through the disabled-key build-70450 available-source route. Structural validation, exact partial-extent coverage and zero-fill checks remain fatal on failure; the sealed bytes are the input to offline VMap authentication.
source_policy.partial_sections: Use the v26/v27 available-source declared-skip rules for Map. One or more authenticated E frames must exactly tile every ordered TACT-declared extent, declarations remain per table, and no decryption or key material is admitted.
source_policy.vmap_map_projection: Offline verification reads the sealed Map with read_vmap_maps_70450 and materializes its VMap projection. Section facts and declared/direct/copy/materialized counts and identities are independently re-derived. VMap materialized rows retain WDT==0 rows for complete graph validation; this is deliberately distinct from terrain's WDT-nonzero projection.
source_policy.domain: Build Maps::from_materialized_selection over the complete materialized VMap graph, then select map:<id> and its active ancestors. Missing, inactive, malformed or unavailable selected ancestors are fatal. MapEntry::is_parent is derived before selection from the complete graph, so children outside the selected domain still make their parent a parent.
source_policy.source_authentication_flags: full_ckey_verified/CKey and encoded_key_authenticated/EKey are acquisition facts reported by the producer. They remain producer_reported and are not independent cryptographic source authentication or a substitute for sealed-Map re-derivation.
source_policy.gameobjects: GODI and global GameObject startup are excluded by profile policy. No GameObjectDisplayInfo request, global TempList model acquisition or GameObjectModels.dtree output is part of v28; this exclusion is not an observed source failure or cause.
source_policy.models: Only models registered by actual selected-domain placement requests are converted and published. Placement-only scope requires zero GODI startup reads and an exact used_models/VMO-artifact inventory.
source_policy.liquids: LiquidMaterial and LiquidType retain the selected-geometry source checks. LiquidObject is out of scope and is not requested.
source_policy.failure_policy: A selected Map, VMap, domain, placement, model or liquid input that fails authentication, structure, exact declaration coverage, associations or a resource limit remains fatal and is never silently omitted.

verification.verify_scope: offline package integrity, intrinsic DB2/VMap formats and associations, exact per-table Map partial declarations, and independently re-derived Map sections, VMap direct/copy/materialized identities and selected active-ancestor domain
verification.verify_links_scope: the same authenticated selected-geometry checks; no terrain, navigation, MMap or external package links are part of v28
independently_derived_facts: Map section availability/admission and per-table partial declarations
VMap declared/direct/copy/materialized counts and ordered identities
selected map and active-ancestor domain from the complete materialized VMap graph
MapEntry::is_parent including children outside the selection
verification.map_materialization: materialize the VMap projection while retaining WDT==0 rows
verification.parent_derivation: MapEntry::is_parent from the complete graph before selected-domain narrowing
verification.source_authentication_flags_scope: CKey/EKey acquisition flags are producer-reported facts, not independent cryptographic proof.

facts: selected map ID and active ancestor closure independently re-derived from sealed Map
Map available-section states, direct/copy/materialized VMap facts and per-table partial declarations
complete-graph MapEntry::is_parent, including children outside the selection
VMap materialized rows retain WDT==0; active selection remains distinct from terrain
GODI/global GameObjects excluded by profile, request_made=false and startup reads zero
placement-only models with exact used_models/VMO-artifact inventory
LiquidObject out of scope and request_made=false
CKey/EKey acquisition flags remain producer_reported, not independent cryptographic proof
size and SHA-256 bindings for every published VMap artifact and placement proof

limits.partial_frames_scope: The total retains the v26/v27 ceiling across selected tables, including Map; the per-table ceiling is the existing CASC max_blte_frames limit and is not raised.
limits.partial_frame_coverage: One or more E frames must exactly tile every ordered TACT-declared extent of Map; crossing, missing, extra or inconsistent coverage rejects.
limits.package_total_bytes_equation: checked_add(collision-output-bytes, 17179869184) where 17179869184 is the 16 GiB DB2 ceiling; overflow rejects
limits.meaning: All seven plan budgets and every product ceiling are downward-only. The package ceiling is the checked sum of collision-output-bytes and the 16 GiB DB2 ceiling. No v22 numeric ceiling is raised, no output is truncated, and component state remains provisional until sealed.

retain every v22 numeric ceiling; accept at most 16 MiB for Map, 16 GiB DB2 total, 65,536 frames per table and 18,576 total; compute package_total_bytes with checked_add(collision-output-bytes, 17179869184), whose maximum is 85,899,345,920 bytes
